_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored. It holds local paths and, if you use SMTP, an app password - so it never gets committed.
_ask_bridge: Everything below is for noriki_ask_bridge.py - the thing that puts OVERSEER's ask_user questions on your phone.

notify._push: ntfy is free and needs no account. Pick a LONG unguessable topic name - anyone who knows it can read your notifications. Install the ntfy app, subscribe to the same topic.
notify._email: Backup channel for when your phone isn't to hand. Leave smtp.host empty and ntfy will forward the email for you - no SMTP setup needed. Fill smtp in only if you'd rather send it yourself.
notify._click: Tapping the notification opens this. Set it to your Pages URL.
